title: Quantum phase transitions of the Cavity Heisenberg spin-chain
authors: Lv-Ting Gong, Shao-Fan He, Fu-Quan Dou
abstract: The interplay between quantum criticality and ergodicity breaking constitutes a central challenge in complex quantum many-body systems. Here, we investigate ground-state quantum phase transitions (QPTs) and excited-state quantum phase transitions (ESQPTs), as well as ergodic-nonergodic transition in the cavity Heisenberg spin-chain (CHS) model. By combining quantum information measures with semiclassical fixed-point analysis, we identify a deformed phase that interpolates between the normal and superradiant phases, featuring a logarithmic nonanalyticity in the density of states (DoS) and two additional jump discontinuities. We further elucidate the spectral-structure mechanism underlying the connection between ESQPTs and the ergodic--nonergodic transition (ENET) via level statistics, participation ratios, and multifractal analysis. Our results provide a general framework for characterizing phase structures and spectral features in light--matter quantum many-body systems.
summary: This paper theoretically investigates quantum phase transitions in the cavity Heisenberg spin-chain model, a system relevant to quantum optics. By combining quantum information measures with semiclassical analysis, the authors map out a phase diagram revealing a unique 'deformed phase.' They establish a deep connection between excited-state transitions and the system's ergodic properties using spectral analysis.
main_problem: The paper investigates ground-state and excited-state quantum phase transitions (QPTs/ESQPTs) and the ergodic-nonergodic transition (ENET) in the cavity Heisenberg spin-chain model.
main_result: The authors identified a novel 'deformed phase' interpolating between normal and superradiant regimes, characterized by logarithmic nonanalyticity in the density of states. They also established a spectral-structure mechanism linking ESQPTs to the ENET.
method: The study combines quantum information measures with semiclassical fixed-point analysis, analyzing the system in the semiclassical limit ($\hbar 	o 0$).
model_or_system: The system is the cavity Heisenberg spin-chain (CHS) model, which couples a Heisenberg spin chain to a single-mode cavity radiation field, relating it to the Dicke model.

main_assumptions: The analysis relies on the semiclassical approximation ($\hbar 	o 0$) and fixed-point analysis of the classical Hamiltonian.
